KITSUNE_FORM_POWER.title: Miko Form
KITSUNE_FORM_POWER.description: Playing a card with base cost 3 grants 1 Foxfire. On leaving: Chase once (spend 1 Foxfire, plus damage equal to remaining Foxfire).
NURSE_FORM_POWER.title: Nurse Form
NURSE_FORM_POWER.description: At turn start, heal HP equal to Healing. At turn end, Healing is halved. On leaving: heal HP equal to Healing.
DIVA_FORM_POWER.title: Diva Form
DIVA_FORM_POWER.description: Advance the battle through Sections (Intro - Main - Chorus - Interlude - Outro).
LADY_FORM_POWER.title: Lady Form
LADY_FORM_POWER.description: The power of Light. On leaving: gain 2 Energy.
HEALING_POWER.title: Healing
HEALING_POWER.description: At turn start, heal HP equal to the stack. At turn end, the stack is halved.
LIGHT_POWER.title: Miss Zhao Is My Light!
LIGHT_POWER.description: The Lady Form special resource, abbreviated as Light.
SECTION_POWER.title: Section
LIBERATION_POWER.title: Liberation
LIBERATION_POWER.description: Temporarily upgrade all cards (base - +; + - ++). Disappears when the Chorus ends.
MAIN_MELODY_POWER.title: Main Melody
MAIN_MELODY_POWER.description: Until your next turn: +1 damage dealt, -1 damage taken.
NURSE_MAIN_HEALING_POWER.title: Main's Care
NURSE_MAIN_HEALING_POWER.description: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 1 Healing.
